digest: Medium, opt-in impact: additional sensitive-data retention, synchronous recording overhead, API failure coupling, and mixed-session trace risks; disabled behavior remains unchanged.

impacts.summary: Original API identity is retained; no recording files are written.
Arguments, outcomes, and error messages receive an additional plaintext copy without redaction, retention limits, or explicit restrictive permissions.

impacts.condition: Recording initialization, serialization, or append fails
impacts.summary: Recorder failures can prevent API calls, reject successful operations, replace original errors, or poison the cached API-load promise.

impacts.condition: Recording enabled, especially with large payloads or frequent polling
impacts.summary: Recursive projection and synchronous file appends block the event loop; recording size and serialization depth are unbounded.

impacts.condition: A recording directory is reused or shared by multiple wrappers or processes
impacts.summary: Appended calls have wrapper-local sequence numbers while surface metadata is overwritten; replay sorts only by sequence and can mix sessions.

impacts.condition: Recordings used for diagnostics or reference replay
impacts.summary: Structured outcomes and full method metadata improve reproducibility, but unfinished calls are absent, values are lossy, and endedAt excludes final serialization and write overhead.

assumptions.statement: The supplied diff defines b83cc4f..7e813aa; related unchanged files were inspected only to establish impact.
Environment configuration is operator-controlled. It is evaluated at initial cached API loading; injected test APIs bypass the seam.
Assessment used read-only inspection. Tests, benchmarks, and fault-injection scenarios were not executed.
Both required upstream control artifacts were read through complete, non-truncated path=$ projections.

The requested ./schemas/api-contract-impact-control.schema.json was absent. Required fields, types, and severity enum were checked manually against the repository copy at workflows/impact-review/schemas/api-contract-impact-control.schema.json; no executable validator was run.
